Tables (from January-March 1994 to April-June 2026)

Ⅰ. GDP (Expenditure Approach) and Its Components

  1. Due to the revisions to source statistics etc., estimates of nominal original series from January-March 2021 and estimates of real original series from January-March 2020 may be revised from previous release.
  2. As seasonal adjustment is conducted with the latest estimates of original series every release, all estimates of both nominal and real seasonally adjusted series from January-March 1994 are revised from previous release. To download the latest estimates for any period, always the latest release should be consulted.
Note: Files are in CSV format.

Ⅱ. Domestic Final Consumption Expenditure of Households Classified by Type, and Exports and Imports of Goods and Services

Domestic final consumption expenditure of households classified by type are estimated by classifying each item of the 116-purpose classification of Domestic final consumption expenditure of households into one of the four categories: Durable goods, Semi-durable goods, Non-durable goods, and Services.

  • (*) Correspondence between classification of goods and services by 116 purposes and four categories of Domestic Final Consumption of Expenditure of Households (PDF:46KB)

Ⅲ. Compensation of Employees

  1. As seasonal adjustment is conducted with the latest estimates of original series every release, all estimates of both nominal and real seasonally adjusted series from January-March 1994 are revised from previous release. To download the latest estimates for any period, always the latest release should be consulted.
  2. Level of seasonally adjusted series is annualized.
  3. Real compensation of employees (reference series) uses Consumption of households (excluding imputed rent and FISIM) deflator and Consumption of households deflator .
